description.zh: 直播流所属应用名称。支持通配符*，代表该域名下所有的AppName。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The name of the application. The wildcard character (\*) is supported. An asterisk (\*) represents all applications under the specified domain name. For more information, see [Stream management](~~197397~~).
The duration of an HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) transport stream (TS) segment. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
是否忽略对应转码流生成时移。取值：

- **true**：转码流不生成时移。

- **false**：转码流生成时移。

默认选择为true。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable time shifting for transcoded streams. Valid values:

- **true**: Time shifting is disabled for transcoded streams.

- **false**: Time shifting is enabled for transcoded streams.

Default value: true.

description.zh: 直播流流名称。支持通配符*，代表该AppName下所有的StreamName。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The name of the stream. The wildcard character (\*) is supported. An asterisk (\*) represents all streams under the specified application. For more information, see [Stream management](~~197397~~).

description.zh: 表示数据保留时长。默认保留7天，单位：天。
description.en: The data retention period. The default value is 7. Unit: days.

descriptions.zh:
直播时移和延迟转码目前暂不支持同时配置。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You cannot configure time shifting and delayed transcoding at the same time.

## QPS limit

This operation supports up to 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. If you exceed this limit, the system throttles your API calls, which can impact your business. To prevent throttling, call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live open-live-shift --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --duration 3 --vision 10 --ignore-transcode true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live OpenLiveShift --region cn-hangzhou --IgnoreTranscode true --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --Vision 10 --Duration 3 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
